Theorem 1.2 is proved algebraically from Theorem 1.1 in Section 2.3 However , in this article; our focus is on providing a fully combinatorial proof of Theorems 1.1 and 1.2 by constructing a probabilistic bijection on non-attacking fillings.

As implications of Theorem 1.2, certain assumptions can be removed from theorems in [Alel9] and [CMW22], which we summarize in Section 4.

The combinatorial interpretation of Theorem 1.2 is that swapping the basement entries in two adjacent columns of the same height does not change the generating function for non-attacking fillings. Our approach for proving this builds upon (classical) bijection introduced in [CHMMW22] for unrestricted fillings of partition shape; in which two adjacent entries of the filling in the bottom rOW of columns of the same height are swapped while preserving the overall weight of the filling: In [Man24], the second author extended this technique by introducing a probabilistic bijection for partition-shaped non-attacking fillings. In this article, we generalize this probabilistic bijection to composition-shaped non-attacking thereby giving a bijective of Theorem 1.2. fillings, proof

Section 3 defines a probabilistic bijection on non-attacking leading to a combinatorial proof of Theorem 1.2 in Section 3.1. Finally; Section 4 discusses some implications of Theorem 1.2 fillings,
